title: Senior Salesforce Admin
description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube https://www.youtube.com/carwow channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

 

BUSINESS INNOVATION @ CARWOW

Join us on a mission to transform how 300+ commercial and operations professionals work every day - by putting Salesforce at the heart of our business.

As part of the Business Innovation team, you won’t just maintain a system - you’ll contribute the evolution of our internal platform strategy. Your role is to empower teams by removing friction, replacing redundant tools, and ensuring Salesforce becomes a single source of truth for how we operate and grow.

We’re looking for someone who sees beyond config and code - someone ready to take ownership, drive adoption, and shape the future of our platform. You’ll play a key role in bringing every user fully onto Salesforce, embedding best practices, and preparing the business to harness automation and AI at scale.

If you’re a Salesforce admin - with the vision to drive impact and the skills to bring others with you - this is your opportunity.

 

YOUR MISSION

We’re looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator to help us scale our internal platforms and processes as we continue to grow at pace. Sitting within the Business Innovation team, you’ll lead the end-to-end delivery of Salesforce initiatives that power our Sales, Customer Experience, and Operations teams.

This is a strategic, hands-on role ideal for someone who’s confident in breaking down requirements, managing sprint delivery, and translating platform vision into tangible outcomes - all while working closely with senior stakeholders.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Drive the intake, analysis, and execution of Salesforce change requests - translating business needs into scalable, maintainable solutions.

- Act as point of contact for complex platform issues, ensuring rapid root-cause resolution and clear communication.

- Lead the full lifecycle of enhancements: scope requirements, design solutions, configure and build, test, and deploy.

- Own the configuration of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud - including custom objects, automation logic, validation rules, permission structures, and reporting models.

- Actively manage technical debt and ensure long-term platform scalability.

- Lead the implementation and optimisation of integrations between Salesforce and internal/external systems to ensure data flows are reliable, secure, and aligned with operational workflows.

- Lead training sessions and create enablement materials tailored for end users, power users, and stakeholders to drive platform adoption and accountability.

- Partner with admins, analysts, and developers to plan and deliver cross-functional features across sales, customer operations, and commercial teams.

- Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and list views to support business reporting needs.

- Support UAT, bug resolution, and user onboarding for all new platform capabilities.

- Identify and implement opportunities for process automation using Flow, approval workflows, and custom notifications.

 

KEY REQUIREMENTS

- Have 5+ years of Salesforce administrator experience, with strong hands-on knowledge of Flows and declarative tools.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Glarus
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Remote Registered Dietitian
description:
About Us:

The United States has the poorest maternal and birth outcomes of all developed countries with the underserved, Black, Brown, Indigenous communities disproportionately affected. Nadia Care is working to drastically change the experience of affected communities by reimagining how we deliver meaningful and compassionate care to expectant moms.

Nadia Care ’s mission is to improve pregnancy, birth and the postpartum journey for women and their families by reimagining how maternity care is delivered. Our team is focused on building trust-based engagement and wrap-around support for expectant moms at home, in person and virtually to ensure they have all the social support they need for a successful and joyful pregnancy journey. We help our members with care navigation, doula support, assistance with lactation, nutrition, housing, transportation and a wide range of other needs. We leverage technology to support our virtual engagement that allows us to meet all our moms where they are.

We ensure that our members have trusted sources for support, resources, and information throughout their pregnancy, delivery and well into postpartum. Nadia Care does not replace the primary obstetrician or doctor’s relationships. Instead, we support expectant mothers with all other health-related social needs not typically available through their doctors’ offices.

Our Values:

•
Empathy is at the heart of everything we do. We must always center the experiences of the mothers and families we serve, as well as support and uplift one another.

•
Collaboration is what makes us stronger. We achieve the greatest impact when we work together, share knowledge, and elevate each other’s strengths.

•
Resilience reflects our ability to push through challenges, adapt in a fast-changing environment, and remain committed to our mission no matter the obstacles.

The Role:
Nadia Care is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD) to join our team. In this role, you will deliver essential, specialized nutrition education and support to expectant and new mothers, especially those navigating high-risk pregnancies or managing chronic health conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and anemia.
As a trusted partner, you will support the health and well-being of Nadia members and their babies through individualized dietary plans, virtual consultations, and education tailored to their nutritional needs. This position will primarily serve our members in Tennessee and potentially other areas in the future beyond what is listed, and report to the Director of Care Delivery.
Work Schedule:
This is a remote, contract position working 5-10 hours a week. The schedule is based on your availability to accept scheduled visits and group classes. You are responsible for being present on our platforms at those provided times.
Responsibilities :

• Deliver individualized perinatal and postpartum nutrition education via scheduled, virtual visits.

• Facilitate scheduled, virtual group classes for perinatal and postpartum nutrition, equipping mothers with essential knowledge for managing pregnancy and optimizing health outcomes.

• Ensure clear and precise documentation for all care interactions.

• Adhere to our policies and procedures to maintain the highest standard of care for our members.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience as a Registered Dietitian (RD) and credentialed by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

• Current licensure to practice in Tennessee (licensure in other states e.g., Maryland, and DC is a plus!)

• Demonstrated experience in providing medical nutrition therapy to perinatal and postpartum individuals managing conditions such as diabetes, hypertension or preeclampsia, inadequate weight gain, and anemia.

• Experience serving families eligible for Medicaid, SNAP, or WIC programs.

title: Pessoa Analista de Mídia PL - Performance (Curitiba/São Paulo)
Applied Scientist/Machine Learning Engineer, Gaia
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

Generative Simulation is the team advancing our end-to-end autonomous driving research, incubating and investing in new ideas that can become game-changing technological advances for Wayve. As a Machine Learning Engineer in the team, you will play a key role in developing next-generation world models and planners, such as GAIA, that can simulate complex, diverse, and temporally consistent driving environments to power faster training, broader testing, and scalable deployment, even in areas and scenarios we have never driven in before. As we push toward the next generation of GAIA, efficiency and interactivity are a major focus: models must run thousands of roll-outs per second, support closed-loop agent interaction, and fit within practical compute budgets. You will work at the intersection of machine learning research, multi-modal modelling, and real-world deployment, tackling questions such as how we can deploy autonomous vehicles in a new geography without collecting any real-world data, and whether synthetically generated environments can fully replace physical testing and data collection.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Setting technical direction: Set technical direction and designing key components of the system.

- Deep work / coding: You spend a focused block implementing and debugging new modeling capabilities.

- Cross-team collaboration, brainstorming and pairing: you brainstorm ideas with your team mates or pair to solve a difficult problem

- Mentorship / async review: You review a teammate’s pull request or experimental design and outcomes and provide feedback

- Sync-ups: Share findings with the rest of your team leading to a discussion on designing the next experiments. You align on shared priorities for the week and blockers.

- Paper reading/ reading groups: Read one of the latest papers and summarise them for yourself or the team to present in the next reading group if interesting

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Invent next-generation, efficient generative world-models (diffusion, transformer or hybrid) that deliver real-time roll-outs and controllable scene editing.

- Architect interactive world models where agents (or humans) can step the model, enabling reinforcement learning, planning and safety evaluation loops.

- Optimise end-to-end performance - from latent compression to context pruning - your aim is to reduce inference latency by orders of magnitude.

- Define robust metrics for long-horizon coherence, physics fidelity and planner integration; run ablations and scaling studies to understand trade-offs.

- Ship impact: integrate your models into closed-loop training and evaluation, and measure the sim-to-real gap against on-road driving-model results.

- Mentor and influence: guide junior researchers, shape technical road-maps, publish at top venues and represent Wayve in the community.

- Challenge assumptions and drive innovation: propose bold ideas, conduct ablation studies, and question conventional approaches to training and evaluation.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- 4+ years of experience in ML research/engineering with a focus on generative video, world models.

- Deep knowledge in diffusion & latent-video models; track record of improving sampling efficiency or model throughput.

- Experience working with high-dimensional temporal or spatial-temporal data (e.g., video, multi-sensor fusion).

- Strong Python and PyTorch engineering fundamentals, and experience building research-grade production tools.

- Strong publication record or contributions to open-source ML tooling.

title: Rack Design Engineer (Data Center) - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Data Center Engineering team designs training and inference compute clusters from first principles, pushing thermal, electrical, and optical systems to the limit of physics. We operate as a highly cross disciplinary team comprised of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software engineers, all working to maximize the efficiency, reliability, and deployment speed of terrestrial computing to serve rapidly scaling demand.

This team owns compute architecture, datacenter network design, rack builds, connectivity, in-house design of our own computers, and the manufacturing line that builds that compute. As a Rack Design Engineer, you will own the rack as a product: structure, power, cooling, service paths, and the physical integration of servers, switches, optics, and liquid cooling from first sketch through production rate.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own mechanical, structural, and integration design of high-density AI compute racks and associated chassis, frames, busbars, manifolds, and cable/fiber raceways

• Integrate compute, networking, power distribution, and liquid cooling into a buildable, serviceable, high-yield rack architecture

• Design for the in-house manufacturing line: DFM/DFA, fixtures, work instructions, incoming inspection, first article, and production ramp

• Close thermal, structural, and power constraints with cooling, electrical, optical, and network counterparts at the cluster level (CDUs, cold plates, quick disconnects, PDUs/busbars, high-current distribution, tray and bend-radius limits)

• Drive vendor and in-house parts from concept to qualified production, including sheet metal, extrusions, busbar, manifolds, cable management, and rack accessories

• Stand on the floor during prototype and production builds: debug fit, leak, cable dress, airflow/liquid balance, and service time; fold issues into the next revision the same day

• Produce and maintain CAD, BOMs, drawings, and build documentation that a line can run at volume

• Support cluster deployment of the racks you design, including first-site bring-up and feedback into the next hardware generation

• Partner with network, optical, electrical, and firmware teams to deploy custom compute for inference and training across SpaceX programs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• 2+ years of professional experience designing electromechanical hardware that was built and shipped (internship and project experience counts toward this if the hardware was physically produced)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Ownership of rack, chassis, or similarly dense electromechanical products through prototype and production

• Experience or background in ethernet switching, networking, interconnects, and high power distribution

• CAD fluency in SolidWorks, Creo, or NX, with released drawings a shop and a factory can build from

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Maritime Manufacturing Technology Team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies, processes, and materials for cutting-edge defense hardware. The team is developing deployable static and moving surfaces, undersea and sea to air vehicles, and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an experienced Metal Former/Machine Operator to join the team, working in a cutting-edge production environment to advance the state-of-the-possible in maritime manufacturing. You will play a key role in delivering our products to our customers by working hands-on with our engineering team on a multi-disciplinary workflow. This role will include fabricating high-quality parts in a cutting-edge production system as well as building assemblies to support the production floor.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Read and interpret technical drawings and CAD models.

• Program/set-up/operate manual, semi-automated and CNC plate rollers, hydraulic presses, and shears.

• Design/spec out and lead implementation of various work holding and fixture methods.

• Act as SME on the rolling/forming/contouring fabrication of pressure vessels, alloys, or varying materials.

• Troubleshoot issues and make adjustments during the manufacturing process.

• Perform quality control both during and at completion of the manufacturing process.

• Lead the organization, machine maintenance, and cleanliness of the work area.

• Collaborate with the Quality and Engineering teams to identify and implement safety policies and procedures.

• Help build, supervise, and mentor the fabrication team on rolling, forming, contouring, safe handling, etc.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years' experience as a metal forming technician.

• Proven experience in setting up and operating plate rolling machines to form cylinders, cones, and other curved shapes of various metal thicknesses (up to 4-6”).

• Extensive experience in operating hydraulic press brakes for forming and bending.

• High level of familiarity with various alloys, metals, etc.

• Knowledgeable in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

• Proficient in using precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, protractors, tape measures).

• Can own the completion of an assigned manufacturing task from start to finish.

• Ability to flex between R&D fabrication and production tasks.

• Able and willing to jump in on production assembly integration tasks as needed.

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs unassisted.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience working with exotic materials like Inconel, Monel, Titanium, and HY-80).

• General fabrication experience (cutting, forming, welding).

• Forklift and/or overhead crane certification or ability to obtain.

• Experience with CAD software like Siemens NX (Unigraphics).

• Prior work with architecture and infrastructure engineering partners and/or general contractors to build, improve or modify machining systems.

• Hobbyist fabricator, welder, builder.

$41.35 — $54.81 USD

title: Transmission Line Engineer II/ III- High Voltage
description:
Role Summary

As a Transmission Line Engineer II/III, you will design the overhead high- and medium-voltage lines that connect utility-scale solar and battery storage projects to the grid. A gen-tie line is often the last link between a finished plant and the energy it delivers, and your work decides whether that link is safe, buildable, and cost-effective. You will turn project requirements into construction-ready designs, working alongside substation, protection and controls, and civil engineers on the High Voltage team. The work you produce will directly support the addition of utility-scale renewable energy generation assets to the power grid.

As an employee-owner, you will share in the results of the work and help build a team where every engineer’s contribution is recognized. Candidates may be considered at either the Engineer II or Engineer III level depending on experience, technical depth, independence, and demonstrated ability to lead scope.

Duties & Responsibilities

Across both levels, this role may include:

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

• Design overhead gen-tie, transmission, and medium-voltage lines in PLS-CADD, including route evaluation, plan and profile development, structure spotting, sag-tension analysis, conductor selection, and clearance verification.

• Model and check wood, steel, and concrete pole structures and lattice towers in PLS-POLE and PLS-TOWER under the governing load cases.

• Prepare structure load sheets and specifications for custom steel poles, and review fabricator drawings for conformance with the design.

• Develop insulator and hardware assemblies, framing details, and bills of material.

• Design or coordinate direct-embed and drilled pier foundations using geotechnical reports and foundation design software.

• Build terrain models and crossing data from LiDAR and survey files for use in line design.

title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT HEX

Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.

Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hex's infrastructure team owns all of our cloud infrastructure (compute, networking, datastores) along with CI/CD and observability, across a multi-tenant platform and single-tenant environments. Every engineer at Hex depends on what the infrastructure team builds.

We're growing in customers, in users, and in the kinds of data workflows our workload compute backend has to support. That growth has opened up a set of projects that would meaningfully change how fast the rest of engineering ships, and we're hiring to take them on.

We're looking for someone who will pick up one of those projects, own it start to finish, and leave it better than they found it. Bring your opinions, including the ones that disagree with ours. Infrastructure tooling is changing quickly right now, and we want someone who's paying attention to that as we improve the foundational components that power Hex.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your first few months, we'll pick two or three of these together based on where you're strongest and where we're looking to invest:

- CI/CD. Hex’s CI/CD pipelines need a glow-up: optimizing for speed, cost, and providing more flexibility.

- Stack lifecycle. Setup, teardown, partial teardown, and updates for single-tenant stacks, today too much of this is manual and runs through our team.

- Postgres at scale. Performance, migrations, and capacity for our multi-tenant production database.

- Cost. Infrastructure spend visibility and reduction.

- Security posture. Workload and container isolation, plus compliance work as we move upmarket.

- Platform features. Customer-facing infrastructure capabilities: private connectivity, customer defined networking, and making single-tenant deployments easier to operate.

ABOUT YOU

- 5+ years building and operating production infrastructure, including on-call

- You make the people around you better, whether or not you've had the title

- Strong Kubernetes operations: you can reason about scheduling, networking, and failure modes, not just apply manifests

- Solid AWS fundamentals (EKS, RDS, VPC networking, IAM)

- Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform

- Comfortable writing and reading enough application code to change a pipeline, a controller, or a service

- You can take a vague, long-standing problem and turn it into something shippable without waiting to be told how

- You write clearly, design docs and runbooks that engineers outside infra can follow

Plus depth in at least one of

- Networking - VPC design, private connectivity (PrivateLink, peering), DNS, TLS and certificate management, agentic sandboxing

- Databases - Postgres at scale: replication, tuning, connection pooling, major version upgrades, migrations under load

- Deployment systems - CI/CD platform ownership, build performance and cost, release and artifact management

OUR STACK

title: Fluidstack Labs Lead
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE FLUIDSTACK LABS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Qualify the hardware the frontier runs on before it runs anywhere else. First samples of next-generation accelerators, switches, storage, and liquid cooling land here, and leave as production-ready platforms with runbooks the whole fleet inherits.

- Compress silicon-to-production to weeks. The lab closes the gap between vendor sample and customer-ready gigawatt infrastructure, and every week cut here pulls the entire 10s-of-GW deployment curve forward.

- Run the lab like a production site. Provisioning, telemetry, demand management, and liquid cooling mirror production architecture exactly, so a qualification pass in the lab is a deployment guarantee in the field.

- Prove the power envelope nobody else will touch. Dynamic demand management lets AI compute deploy beyond nominal electrical capacity, and the lab validates the full detection-to-shutdown response chain that makes it safe.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the NPI lab end to end: a direct-liquid-cooled facility with CDU-fed rows and an air-cooled zone that mirror production architecture, and take it fully operational by end of year.

- Build and lead the on-site team of data center technicians and lab qualification engineers, and serve as the first escalation point for facility-floor issues.

- Schedule and deconflict qualification programs across vendor sample timelines: next-generation accelerator platforms (NVIDIA, AMD, custom accelerators), Ethernet switching on the Broadcom Tomahawk and Jericho families and NVIDIA Spectrum, converged NVMe storage platforms (Weka, Hammerspace, VAST Data), and CDU platforms (nVent, CoolIT, Vertiv). You own operations, scheduling, and execution while an NPI technical program manager and per-domain technical leads (compute and storage, networking, optics and fiber, cooling and controls) drive the technical content of each program.

- Run the multi-party access model under which hardware partners and customers qualify their own equipment in the lab, including customer-owned hardware, NDAs and access agreements, badging coordination, vendor escort, and provisioned remote access.

- Own lab logistics: equipment receiving, asset inventory, rack-and-stack execution quality, RMA handling, migration and standup of lab infrastructure, and coordination of CDU manifold connections and leak inspection with deploymen

Job Description:
Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships

Third Derivative Overview
Third Derivative (D3), a program of RMI , accelerates climate innovation by bringing together startups, investors, corporations, and technical and market experts to help promising climate technologies reach commercial scale.
Through our global accelerator and broader ecosystem, D3 works with hundreds of climate technology companies across major emissions sectors and a network of leading venture investors, corporations, and other capital providers.
Access to the right type of capital at the right stage is one of the most important challenges facing climate technology companies. D3 is building a comprehensive approach to helping startups navigate that challenge-supporting companies in developing effective capital strategies, connecting them with relevant investors and funding partners, and developing new capital solutions where gaps exist.
We are seeking a Senior Associate to help drive this work.

Position Overview
The Senior Associate, Investments & Fund Partnerships will help D3 startups access the capital they need to grow and scale.
Working across D3's portfolio, the Senior Associate will identify companies' financing needs and help develop and deliver the right solutions. This may mean working directly with founders to develop their fundraising strategy and connecting them with relevant investors and capital providers; or, where existing sources of capital do not adequately meet portfolio needs, helping D3 design and launch new financing solutions, partnerships, or investment vehicles.
The role sits at the intersection of startup finance, investor engagement, and capital innovation. The Senior Associate will develop a strong understanding of both startup financing needs and capital-provider mandates and use those insights to connect the two-and to identify where new solutions are needed.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver capital solutions to D3 startups

• Work directly with D3 startups to understand their financing needs, readiness, and potential capital pathways.

• Advise founders on fundraising strategy, including the appropriate type and timing of capital, investor targeting, financing trade-offs, and preparation for investor conversations.

• Connect startups with relevant investors and capital providers across venture equity, strategic capital, debt, project finance, non-dilutive and catalytic capital, and other financing pathways.

• Help companies understand investor requirements and what needs to be true to successfully access different forms of capital.

• Track portfolio financing needs and outcomes to identify recurring challenges and opportunities for D3 to provide additional support.
Build and activate the capital ecosystem

• Develop and deepen relationships with investors and capital providers relevant to D3 startups.

• Build a strong understanding of investor mandates, investment criteria, and emerging areas of interest to enable targeted, high-quality introductions.

• Create opportunities for meaningful engagement between D3 startups and capital partners, including curated introductions, investor sessions, and other targeted programming.

• Use insights from investors and startups to identify gaps between the capital available in the market and the financing needs of climate technology companies.
Support D3’s investment and capital solutions strategy

• Support the deployment and management of D3’s existing investment vehicles and contribute an investor perspective to startup selection and portfolio strategy.

• Track portfolio financing needs and outcomes to identify recurring capital gaps and opportunities for D3 to provide additional support.

• Where relevant, research and evaluate potential new capital solutions, partnerships, or investment vehicles that respond to portfolio needs.

• Support the design, fundraising, structuring, and implementation of new capital initiatives as opportunities emerge.

ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase Storage https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything.

We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all!

You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing.

You will be contributing to both our open source server https://github.com/supabase/storage and upstream dependencies we use, like the TUS server https://github.com/tus/tus-node-server/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+author%3Afenos+is%3Amerged.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Improving our analytics bucket offering and improving the storage of open file formats like iceberg and ducklake

- Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications

- Building out our edge network to speed up uploads and build features like automatic cache invalidation

- Improve the performance, observability, and reliability of our storage server

- Work with the frontend team to build a fast, powerful storage explorer

- Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform

- Demonstrate an ownership mentality: driving projects end-to-end

- Display empathy towards developer experience

NICE-TO-HAVE

- Prior experience working on developer tools

- Solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

- Direct experience designing and operating large file upload/download pipelines at scale

- Deep, practical CDN integration and optimization knowledge

- Experience with image and video processing tools (sharp, dssim, ffmpeg), formats and codecs (AVIF, WebM, Brotli) is a plus

- Experience with the frontend ecosystem (Next.js, React, etc) is a plus

As a Senior Global Compensation Partner at Seismic , you'll be a trusted advisor to our HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition team and business leaders on their most complex pay questions, across North America (United States, Canada), Europe (United Kingdom, Germany, France) and Asia-Pacific (Australia, China, India). We're looking for someone who wants to be at the forefront of compensation. You'll use frontier AI models to rethink how the work gets done from first principles: pricing every job against the market in hours, modeling a program change across 1,700 employees in an afternoon, and building tools that didn't exist a year ago. • 8+ years of compensation experience, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

title: Backend Developer
description:
About the role
We are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.
This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy: you’ll take a bug report or change request, investigate it across the codebase, and see it through to production. You’ll balance production support with feature engineering, backed by a supportive team, and we’re embracing agentic development with AI coding agents to ship efficiently without compromising quality.
Key responsibilities

• Resolve production issues: Triage, diagnose, and resolve issues across distributed microservices, tracing a request from the user-facing API down to the services that talk to external systems.

• Support incident response: Investigate root causes, apply fixes, add regression tests, and document findings so issues don’t recur

• Deliver enhancements: Build improvements to existing services, including new versions of certification programs, scorecard and scoring changes, payment adjustments, and integration updates

• Work within the architecture: Follow established patterns and shared internal libraries in a layered service architecture, from the API gateway through the business logic services down to the adapters that integrate with external systems

• Maintain integrations: Maintain and extend integrations with external platforms for performance data, CRM, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payment processing, email, and cloud file storage

• Manage data changes: Write and update database migration scripts and investigate data-related production issues carefully against live data

• Partner with QA and product: Answer testers’ questions, clarify expected behavior, help reproduce issues, and support verification so fixes and features can be signed off smoothly. Ask product clarifying questions early and confirm intent and edge cases

• Improve observability and documentation: Contribute structured logging, masking of sensitive data, and clearer production visibility, and take part in code review while keeping documentation current as the platform grows

Required qualifications

• Proven ability to take ownership of a problem from start to finish, from initial bug report or change request through to a tested, deployed solution

• Production experience building and maintaining backend services with Node.js and TypeScript

• Strong experience with NestJS (or a comparable structured backend framework), including modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, and middleware

• Solid REST/HTTP fundamentals, including service-to-service communication, API contracts, versioning, and error handling

• Comfortable with relational databases, writing and reviewing PostgreSQL queries, and safe migration practices

• Experience debugging distributed systems where a single feature spans several services, reading logs and metrics to find root causes rather than symptoms

• Sound judgment about risk, including the difference between a safe local fix and a change that calls for a rollout plan, particularly for payments, authentication, and live data

• Experience integrating third-party systems (payment providers, CRMs, ERPs, identity providers) behind a clean internal interface

• Understanding of authentication patterns: OAuth 2.0, JWT verification, single sign-on (SSO), and service-to-service (machine-to-machine) authentication

• Comfortable with agentic development, using AI coding agents and tooling to investigate, build, and ship work efficiently while keeping a careful eye on quality

• Ability to write tests that confirm fixes and prevent regressions

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear status updates, incident notes, pull request descriptions, and documentation others can act on

Nice to have

• Experience supporting a platform through the transition from active build to maintenance-and-enhancement mode

title: Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
description:
The role

As a Senior Manager, Corporate Strategy & Development , you will work in a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO .

You will work across the team's full agenda: Group and business unit strategy, portfolio and capital allocation decisions, and M&A. You are hands-on: you build the financial models, analysis and executive-level outputs yourself. You work under the guidance of the team leadership, owning the quality of analysis and models within your workstreams as well as the respective internal stakeholder relationships.

What you’ll do

• Corporate Strategy : Support the development of the Group's mid-term strategy by driving the process, own the underlying analysis, strategic synthesis, and preparation of strategic documents.

• Business Unit Strategy: Act as an internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.

• M&A Strategy: Drive workstreams for M&A projects, building and owning financial models, analyzing targets, preparing negotiations and supporting the M&A processes the team owns.

• Portfolio Optimization: Contribute to the strategic analysis for key portfolio decisions, including potential geo-expansions, new vertical or brand launches or divestments.

• Capital Allocation: Develop and improve the analytical frameworks and models to support our strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.

What you’ll bring

• Experience: 4+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team.

• Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.

• Financial Acumen: Strong financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended models used for investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.

• DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.

• Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentations and memos for an executive audience. 

• How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.

What you will get in return:

• 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes

• Company pension scheme

• Gym membership

• Bupa private medical insurance (including dental & family cover options)

• Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme

• Nursery support scheme

• Cycle to work scheme

• Group Life Assurance

Location : The HelloFresh Farm, 60 Worship Street, EC2A 2EZ, London

We offer a hybrid working policy for eligible roles, allowing flexibility to work from home and in the office. For more details on eligibility and how this applies to the role you're applying for, please consult with your recruiter.

description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Spend Management Ops supports the broader Spend Management organization - Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense, Procurement Contracts, Sourcing, and Procurement - by building AI-driven solutions, managing project delivery, stewarding the data that underpins those solutions, and developing forward-looking roadmaps for each domain.

We're building this team from the ground up. That means real ownership over how Spend Management operates, not just executing tickets. We partner with the domain teams we support - co-owning the roadmap, bringing ideas to the table, and helping teams think through what they actually need rather than just responding to requests as they arrive.

We operate inside Snowflake's core values - Customer First, Integrity, Own It, Think Big, Be Excellent, Get It Done, Make Each Other the Best, and Embrace Differences - and hold each other to them as the standard, not as posters on a wall.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Business Systems Analyst who brings deep, hands-on experience in either Travel & Expense or Procurement & Sourcing and can operate credibly on both the business-process side and the technical side. You understand how these processes actually run day to day - the exceptions, the workarounds, the places where policy and practice diverge - and you can translate that understanding into systems, automations, and AI-driven solutions that make the process better.

- Proactively manage cross-team dependencies - with Engineering, BI, and the domain teams you support - rather than simply tracking them.

- Unblock others' delivery, not just your own.

Partnership

- Shape what your stakeholders should be asking for, rather than waiting to be asked.

- Be trusted on prioritization tradeoffs, including the ability to say no with a reason stakeholders accept.

- Operate as a de facto extension of the domain team you support.

Technical Capability

- Scope and ship solutions to ambiguous problems with minimal guidance - from process redesign to automation to AI-driven tooling.

- Before recommending a build, consistently evaluate whether the underlying process should change first.

- Set the technical standard for your domain - your patterns get adopted by others on the team.

Ownership

- Resolve most ambiguity independently; escalate only the genuinely hard calls, well-framed with a recommendation attached.

- Frame decisions so others on the team can reuse the same logic.

Influence

- Mentor or unblock colleagues working in adjacent domains.

- Introduce approaches that get adopted elsewhere on the team.

- Be the person others come to for a specific class of problem in T&E or Procurement & Sourcing.
